messages:
Sam: Quick sync - Prospect (MedSys) needs a Dedicated POC. Requirements: static egress IP for allowlisting, support for client cert authentication, and they'd prefer IPv6 end-to-end but can accept IPv4 for now.
Olivia: IPv6 end-to-end on Dedicated is only available on Private/VPC. For a quick POC we can offer IPv4 static egress + customer-side TLS proxy or token exchange.
Diego: We also have a short-lived dual-stack NAT gateway we can enable in some regions as a workaround (IPv6 -> NAT64 -> IPv4 egress). Not GA but used for a couple trials.
Sam: They said their security team insists on cert-based auth (mTLS). Can the proxy approach meet their compliance needs?
Heather: Yes if the proxy preserves client identity and we get an auditable chain. Options: (1) customer proxy terminates mTLS and forwards an HMAC-signed X-Client-Identity header, or (2) proxy mTLS -> exchange for short-lived token from our auth service, then call our endpoint with token. We require the questionnaire and emergency revocation contact either way.
Olivia: For the token exchange we have a simple flow: proxy does mTLS to our auth endpoint, receives a 1h token and calls the Dedicated sandbox. Sample: curl --cert /path/proxy.crt --key /path/proxy.key https://auth.redwood.example/v1/token -d 'scope=poc' then curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" https://dedi-poc.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"input":"ping"}'.
Diego: If they insist on native IPv6 we can propose a Private sandbox deployment (their VPC) but that adds ~48-72h lead time for infra & approvals.
Sam: Timeline: they want to test within 24h. Which track is fastest?
Olivia: Fastest: Dedicated sandbox + reserved IPv4 egress + proxy or NAT64 workaround. We can allocate a static egress IP and provide DNS/NAT64 instructions. ETA ~6-8 hours.
Heather: I'll send the security checklist now: network diagram, CIDR ranges to allow, proxy cert chain and rotation cadence, emergency revoke contact, and the completed questionnaire.
Sam: Pricing question: any fees for a one-week POC?
Diego: Typically we waive the platform fee for strategic deals; we bill SRE hours past the ops support SLAs. If NAT64 or custom infra is required we may charge a small ops pass-through. I'll flag it on the quote.
Sam: Great. Can we hand them a curl example for the proxy header pattern?
Heather: Yes, simple example: curl -v https://dedi-poc.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "X-Client-Identity: $(cat client.pem | base64)" -H "X-Client-Signature: <HMAC>" -H "Authorization: Bearer DEDICATED-TEMP-KEY" -d '{"input":"hello"}'.
deploy-bot: provisioning:dedi-poc-1787 queued (ETA ~6h) :rocket:
Olivia: Once provisioned we'll provide the reserved egress IP and the temporary API key. Sam: I'll send ACME the two-track proposal (fast proxy/NAT64 track + full Private IPv6 track) and the checklist. Will update when they decide.
